resources.string: Tap Stream screen and allow the capture: the MMI shows this phone\'s screen, up to Max fps pictures a second (the MMI may manage fewer). Format: JPEG is small and fast, PNG keeps text sharp but is bigger and slower, PNG when still sends JPEG while the screen moves and the same picture as PNG once it stops. Switch to any app, turn the phone, unplug and replug: the streaming carries on until you stop it here or from its notification.
